final: WITH budget_with_event AS (SELECT b.budget_id, b.spent, b.amount, e.event_id, e.type, CAST(b.spent AS FLOAT) / b.amount as spending_rate FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id), event_rates AS (SELECT event_id, type, AVG(spending_rate) as event_avg_rate FROM budget_with_event GROUP BY event_id, type), type_rates AS (SELECT type, AVG(event_avg_rate) as type_avg_rate FROM type_rates GROUP BY type), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg_rate) as overall_avg FROM type_rates) SELECT t.type, t.type_avg_rate, t.type_avg_rate / o.overall_avg as normalized_rate FROM type_rates t CROSS JOIN overall_mean o
